steps.objective: File the shelf: `dap`, `p`. Copy the blue: `yap`, `P`.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.name: Index
lines.text:
Oh good, hands. I'm Index. This shelf is filed
wrong. It goes below the bibles, the brown one.

lines.speaker: system
lines.text:
In the shelf, press `dap`: it lifts, empty row
and all. Then `}` to the next empty row, `p`.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.name: Index
lines.text:
And the blue one, the atlases: I want a copy by
the door, just above the bottom rail.

lines.speaker: system
lines.text:
In the blue shelf, press `yap`. Then `G` to the
bottom rail, and `P`: it lands above.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.name: Index
lines.text:
Atlases, bibles, the misfiled shelf, and a copy
by the door. In order, for once.

line.speaker: npc
line.name: Index
line.text:
The Notary signed every one of these.
He's in the vault. He'll want them back.

line.speaker: system
line.text:
Below the archive, the vault.
Someone is signing, and signing.
